objective.goal: Use the accepted specification to plan and perform a normal-operation experiment and a declared fault experiment on the live PLC. From returned PLC evidence, choose and execute a genuinely new follow-up investigation; cite its motivating observations. Produce grounded findings and finish with the controller Stopped, fault-free, no tracked item or pending completion.
objective.discretion: Choose your own hypotheses, fault, stimuli, observations and follow-up. No scripted sequence or predetermined verdict is supplied. Four model decisions are available; group compatible semantic actions thoughtfully. If the budget or evidence is insufficient, report the missing proof honestly.
objective.operation: WCS assign_route is separate from carton requestedRoute metadata. Observe the actual completion sequence before acknowledging it. Stop and Reset are distinct sequenced operator commands. Default hold freezes world advancement while PLC scans and timers continue; do not assume a held active carton stops its PLC transit timer. Engine streaming continues independently of reasoning.
objective.boundaries: Preserved generated world 0.5.0; actual PLC build 8001/interface 1. No world/PLC edits, HMI operation, higher-rate qualification or automatic recovery. HMI pixels are separate engineer evidence.
